summary: State-reset virtual dispatch wrapper. Reads the vtable pointer from this+0x0, clears the state/flag dword at this+0xC to 0, then dispatches through the vtable slot at offset +0x10 (4th slot) with no arguments and returns its result. No guards; always clears then dispatches. Called by OnScreen_Restart (0049f000), sub_4D8760 (004d8760), VehicleStateUpdate (004d9fe0) and ThunkToSub4D7E30 (004db110).

local_names.this: object whose vtable pointer is read from +0x0 and whose +0xC flag is cleared before dispatch
local_names.v1: vtable pointer read from this+0x0, base for the +0x10 dispatch slot

operations.description: Reads the vtable pointer from this+0x0 into v1 as the dispatch base
Clears the state/flag dword at this+0xC to 0 before dispatching
Dispatches the function pointer at vtable+0x10 (4th vtable slot) with no arguments
Returns the result of the dispatched vtable function
